identity.title: Lucario and the Mystery of Mew (manga)

leadText: Lucario and the Mystery of Mew (Japanese: ミュウと の ルカリオ Mew and the -Guiding Hero: Lucario) is a adaptation of the movie of the same name. It was adapted by 伊原しげかつ Shigekatsu Ihara, creator of the Pokémon manga Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure! and Pokémon Battle Frontier. There are also at least two short manga adaptations of the same movie, one by Emiko Yoshino and one by Miho Asada.
plainText:
Lucario and the Mystery of Mew (Japanese: ミュウと の ルカリオ Mew and the -Guiding Hero: Lucario) is a adaptation of the movie of the same name. It was adapted by 伊原しげかつ Shigekatsu Ihara, creator of the Pokémon manga Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure! and Pokémon Battle Frontier. There are also at least two short manga adaptations of the same movie, one by Emiko Yoshino and one by Miho Asada.

==Publications==
 
 
 
 
 
 

==Chapters==
The Blue Adventurer Appears!
Mystery of the Tree of Beginning
Truth Behind the Legend!!

==Differences between the movie and the manga==
 
Throughout the manga, Aaron is just reffered to as Aaron. Lucario in the whole manga refers him as "Master Aaron".
The mother and daughter, , and Freddy are absent in this manga version of the movie.
Due to their absence, Max and read the story of the history of Rota to their friends, instead.
Due to Jenny's absence, it is unknown if Ash was still not allowed to get out of his chair or not.
is not seen bringing the staff back to Queen Rin after is sealed in it in the manga version, leaving it unclear as to how it was sent back in this version.
keeps her hairstyle in the manga and doesn't change it.
In addition, the decoration on the back of her dress is missing.
doesn't wear his knight suit.
Kidd is seen dancing with Brock in the movie. In the manga, she is only seen eating at the buffet.
Kidd's hair is straight down instead of in curly twintails like in the movie when wearing her ballgown, and her head accessories are missing.
In the movie, the knock out with an that counters his . In the manga, he is instead knocked out by the Weavile kicking him.
When the Weavile attack, protects itself by ing into one and attacking one of the real Weavile, resulting into the two fighting.
In the manga, when Ash is asked to raise the staff, he isn't ask to send the fireworks signal nor were fireworks seen unlike in the movie.
The scenes where the characters stop for lunch and at the hot springs and where they go camping aren't present in the manga.
Lucario was also not given any chocolate in the manga
The scenes with the green tunnels full of bubbles inside the Tree of Beginning are cut. However, the doorway to tunnel can still be seen.
When Ash and Lucario fight, they don't fall into a pond, but instead have Brock use his to stop their fight with .
Because the lunch scene was altered, the group instead meets after Ash and Lucario's quarrel.
In the manga, those who control the aura can see other creatures through the Tree of Beginning's crystals, and Ash was able to see Pikachu in one of them. This plot point wasn't relevant in the original movie.
destroys Kidd's jeep in this manga, instead of just throwing it, like in the movie.
Brock, May, Max, Jessie, and James are all seen being swallowed at the same time in the same area by the Tree's blob cells in the manga, rather than Jessie and James getting swallowed first, then followed by Brock, May, and Max.
In the movie, Ash meets Pikachu again on the crystal bridges, in the manga, they reunite when Ash is getting swallowed by the Tree of Beginning's cells.
In the original movie, Sir Aaron takes off both of his gloves. In the manga, however, only one glove is seen taken off and worn by Ash when he decides to use his aura.
The crystal that encased Sir Aaron doesn't disappear when Lucario passes on, and instead stays and encases his body, too.
Ash's group don't meet up with their friends outside after the Tree of Beginning is saved, but instead, they find the boy, Pikachu, and Kidd.
Due to Kidd's jeep getting destroyed, Mew instead takes the group back by transforming into a and letting Ash, Pikachu, May, Max, Brock, and Kidd ride on its back.
On the last page, Team Rocket is seen sitting ontop of the Tree of Beginning.
